ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with a low frequency of high-intensity (white) localized clusters; estimated macro-ratio of approximately 95:5.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant solid dark pigmentation across the majority of the surface; scattered high-contrast circular ring motifs (scars) distributed across both lobes; localized high-intensity white clusters at the distal tips corresponding to calcified biological attachments.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 105 degrees and a moderate depth relative to the total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge boundary featuring high-frequency serrations (peaks and valleys); amplitude of serration increases toward the distal tips, particularly on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory originating from the median notch and extending toward the tips; both lobes exhibit a broad, paddle-like expansion profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density distribution of circular and semi-circular white pixel clusters (ring scars) concentrated in the mid-sections of both lobes, particularly the central-left region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, roughly vertical high-contrast linear marks are detectable on the mid-left lobe, breaking the dark pigmentation pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, high-texture clusters of barnacles are attached to the extreme distal edges of both lobes, causing significant deviation from the natural geometric contour.
other_distinctive_markers: The combination of high-density circular 'ring' scarring across the dark ventral surface and heavy calcified encrustation at the tips provides a highly unique visual signature.
